# kopia_algorithms (Data Source)

Lists the algorithms the Kopia server's release supports, as its UI offers them for a new repository: hashing, encryption, error correction, splitting and compression. It describes the server's Kopia release, not the repository it has open — `kopia_repository_status` reports the algorithms the repository uses — and works without a repository connected.

Useful to check the names a policy uses, such as `compression.compressor_name` and `splitter.algorithm` of `kopia_policy`. Policies also accept the compressor `none`, which is not listed. `lz4` is listed as deprecated, but from Kopia 0.23 on it can neither compress nor decompress anything; `zstd-best-compression` is deprecated too.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kopia_algorithms" "this" {}

locals {
  # The compressors a policy can use: those Kopia does not deprecate, plus
  # "none", which policies accept but Kopia does not list.
  kopia_compressors = concat(
    ["none"],
    [for c in data.kopia_algorithms.this.compression : c.id if !c.deprecated],
  )
}

output "kopia_compressors" {
  value = local.kopia_compressors
}

output "default_splitter" {
  value = data.kopia_algorithms.this.default_splitter # e.g. "DYNAMIC-4M-BUZHASH"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `compression` (Attributes List) Compression algorithms. Kopia has no default compression: a policy turns it on. Kopia lists the algorithms that are not deprecated first, then the deprecated ones, each part sorted by `id`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--compression))
- `default_ecc` (String) Error-correction algorithm Kopia uses for a new repository when error correction is turned on, which it is not by default.
- `default_encryption` (String) Encryption algorithm Kopia uses for a new repository unless told otherwise.
- `default_hash` (String) Hash algorithm Kopia uses for a new repository unless told otherwise.
- `default_splitter` (String) Splitter Kopia uses for a new repository unless told otherwise.
- `ecc` (Attributes List) Error-correction algorithms. Kopia lists the algorithms that are not deprecated first, then the deprecated ones, each part sorted by `id`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ecc))
- `encryption` (Attributes List) Encryption algorithms. Kopia lists the algorithms that are not deprecated first, then the deprecated ones, each part sorted by `id`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--encryption))
- `hash` (Attributes List) Hash algorithms. Kopia lists the algorithms that are not deprecated first, then the deprecated ones, each part sorted by `id`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--hash))
- `splitter` (Attributes List) Splitters, which cut files into chunks. `FIXED` and `DYNAMIC` are older names of `FIXED-4M` and `DYNAMIC-4M-BUZHASH`. Kopia lists the algorithms that are not deprecated first, then the deprecated ones, each part sorted by `id`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--splitter))

<a id="nestedatt--compression"></a>
### Nested Schema for `compression`

Read-Only:

- `deprecated` (Boolean) Whether Kopia has deprecated the algorithm. Only compression algorithms are ever marked.
- `id` (String) Name of the algorithm, as Kopia's settings and policies take it.
